note: AD-152 (owner's Medicine ladder): residents sometimes fall ill and are healed only by the village's medicine. sick_permille_per_day: the chance an adult or child falls ill on a village day; cure_ticks: time a patient lies in the hospital with a medic at work (one bandage when cured); visits_level: from this clinic level the medics walk to the sick at home; medicine_level: the sick are cured where they are with a bandage from the clinic (medicine carried to them); automatic_level: everyone is healed without medics.
